note: The Capsule's keymap: the global keys that open it (Sources/Host/Hotkeys.swift), the in-panel keys (Sources/Host/Panel.swift key()), and the footer hints that advertise them per state (Sources/UI/CapsuleView.swift CapsuleLayout.footerHints/hints). Windows uses Alt+Space for its own panel (C1w); the global-open row here is Mac-only context.

global.action: open the Capsule at the front app
global.note: needs Input Monitoring; a Control press combined with any other key or modifier during the hold is a chord and is discarded, never counted as the double-tap

global.action: open the Capsule at the front app
global.note: a Carbon hot key, needs no permission; the chord is configurable via VYRE_CAPSULE_HOTKEY and always exists even when Control-twice is off

panel.action: layered cancel: cancel talking, then cancel a presence ask, then cancel a credential ask, then stop/clear a live vyre command, then close a confirm, then stop a running reply, then clear the answer or follow-up box, then clear typed text, then hide the panel
remove the last attachment

panel.condition: box is empty and a target chip is set
panel.action: drop the @ chip (a child chip first)
pick the @ row

panel.condition: caret at end of box, and memory is shown or was asked
panel.action: show or fold memory's sources
ask the same question again on the deeper model
open the answer's thread in Vyre chat on the box

panel.condition: an answer is asked and its card overflows
panel.action: scroll the answer card to the top

panel.condition: an answer is asked and its card overflows
panel.action: scroll the answer card to the end

panel.condition: an answer is asked and its card overflows
panel.action: scroll the answer card up one line

panel.condition: an answer is asked and its card overflows
panel.action: scroll the answer card down one line
page the answer card up
page the answer card down
scroll the answer card to the top
scroll the answer card to the end
move the selection down one result row
move the selection up one result row
save the key being added
ask the question, or (with an answer already on screen) keep it and open the follow-up box; also stops the mic on a plain return while listening
think deeper on the same question or follow-up; on a selected row, its own cmd+return action

panel.condition: not a question, not offline-start; a plain row is selected
panel.action: run the selected row

panel.condition: nothing selected in the text field
panel.action: copy the current row
a result row's own declared cmd+letter action, unless the letter is one of the standard app/window/edit shortcuts (a, v, x, z, f, w, comma, q, o, delete) or an arrow key

footer_hints.note: CapsuleLayout.footerHints(m) returns at most 4 of these, chosen by state, left to right. Hint = {title, keys}.

hints.title: Send or Accept
hints.note: label is Accept for a lesson, else Send

hints.title: Allow or Accept
hints.note: label is Accept for a lesson, else Allow

hints.title: Hide or Clear
hints.note: label is Hide when the box is empty, else Clear

hints.title: <the row's cmd+return action, or Send, or Open in Vyre>
hints.note: cmd+S is used instead when the row's alt action id is send-box
